root.label: Silvia Zhang and Guojun Xuan arrested and charged in Arcadia child abuse case

events.label: Silvia Zhang and Guojun Xuan arrested and charged in Arcadia child abuse case

slots.name: number of search warrants
slots.sentence: Silvia Zhang and Guojun Xuan were arrested Tuesday after authorities served a search warrant at their Arcadia mansion as part of a child abuse investigation.

slots.name: number of charges
slots.sentence: They have been charged with conspiracy to commit child abuse and witness intimidation.

slots.name: felony counts against Xuan
slots.sentence: Xuan also faces one felony count of child abuse, one felony count of accessory after the fact, and five felony counts of dissuading a witness.

slots.name: counts against Zhang
slots.sentence: Zhang also faces one count of accessory after the fact and four counts of dissuading a witness.

events.label: Arraignment and $100 million bail request for Zhang and Xuan
